instruction: I need to create a snapshot from this video. Please extract a frame from the video and save it as "snapshot.jpg" in /home/user/.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting a frame/screenshot from video using VLC snapshot feature or ffmpeg. The image should be between 5KB-5MB (reasonable for a video frame) and be a valid JPEG. Evaluator checks file size range and JPEG format.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements

Evaluator checks: (1) file exists at /home/user/snapshot.jpg [via vm_file getter], (2) file size 5KB-5MB [reasonable for video frame], (3) valid JPEG format [checks FF D8 magic bytes]
Complete coverage: instruction does NOT specify which frame/timestamp to extract, so verifying ANY valid JPEG snapshot is sufficient
Getter logic correct: vm_file retrieves file from VM at specified path
Metric logic correct: check_video_snapshot__1391f174 properly validates file existence, size range, and JPEG format
